question.text: Under the Gordon Growth Model, P0 = D1/(r - g). If D1 = Rs. 10, r = 12%, g = 7%, intrinsic value is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.47 gives the Gordon Growth Model as P0 = D1/(r - g). Substituting D1 = 10, r = 0.12, g = 0.07 gives P0 = 10 / (0.12 - 0.07) = 10 / 0.05 = Rs. 200. The Trap: The other choices come from arithmetic errors in computing (r - g) or in dividing by the denominator. Note: P0 here is the intrinsic value per p.47's definitions of D1, r, and g.
